title: The September Sitting is open
dek: Thirty painted dog portraits, one for every September day, now sitting at /kennel-club. Flat acrylic color, a screenprint accent, a name and a breed for each. Mint details follow once the edition, price, and signer are set.
body:
Thirty portraits. Thirty September dates. One dog keeps the chair every day.

Kennel Club begins with the first two sittings already on the calendar, then continues one plate at a time through the end of the month. Each portrait has its own name, breed, room, and place in the sequence. The calendar is the edition list. The room at /kennel-club is open now; mint details follow only after the edition, price, and signer are set.

Start with today's sitting, then take the whole month in order. Nothing is hidden behind a feed: every dog has a date, a plate, and a permanent place in the record. There is a plain-text sheet at /send/kennel-club you can text to one person.
